📖 How to use

      
  1. Choose which value you know.
  2. Type its value.
  3. Press Calculate to get radius, diameter, circumference and area.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
How is radius found from area?
From A = πr², so r = √(A / π).
What is the difference between diameter and circumference?
Diameter is the straight line through the center (2r); circumference is the distance around the circle (2πr).
Are the results exact?
They use the full precision of π in JavaScript, rounded to 6 decimals for display.
